definitions.incomeTaxExpense: Positive expense, negative benefit; continuing-operations tax where separately presented.
definitions.totalEquity: Consolidated total equity including NCI when applicable.
definitions.cashAndEquivalents: Cash/equivalents only; excludes securities, restricted cash and nonmarketable investments.

definitions.investedCapitalBookProxy: totalEquity + debt - cashAndEquivalents; unadjusted book-funding proxy, not operating invested capital.
definitions.effectiveTaxRate: Reported tax/pretax ratio as historical evidence, not endorsed forecast marginal tax rate.
